buyerSummary: Lightweight metal tinplate badges with full-color printed fronts and pin or magnet backing — a cost-effective choice for campaigns, events and giveaways.
overviewParagraphs: Custom tinplate badges are lightweight metal badges with a printed full-color front and a pin or magnet attachment on the back. They are a cost-effective, durable format for brand logos, campaign messaging, event merchandise and promotional giveaways.
Tinplate badges print vibrant, detailed artwork at scale, making them ideal for large-quantity projects where consistent color and a low unit cost matter most.

faqs.question: What is the MOQ for tinplate badges?
faqs.answer: MOQ: 200 pcs per design and construction for bulk production.

faqs.question: Can I request a pre-production sample?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production sample development is available for custom projects so you can verify print color and backing before bulk production.

faqs.question: Can I submit an inquiry without final artwork?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can submit your project now and send artwork later, or provide a reference image for our team to review.

faqs.question: What design files can I send?
faqs.answer: PNG, JPG, PDF, AI or SVG files work well. High-resolution files with clear color references help us reproduce your design accurately.

faqs.question: Can you help choose the right backing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pin backing suits clothing and lanyards, while magnet backing suits fridges, whiteboards and lockers. Our team can advise.

faqs.question: Can you provide test reports?
faqs.answer: Test reports and compliance documentation can be supported according to selected materials, product construction and destination-market requirements.

faqs.question: How are badges packed and shipped?
faqs.answer: Individual or bulk packing is available, and shipment is arranged according to your confirmed order, destination and payment terms.
